CA.rationale: Content (red positions) is paired with a processing/origin entry for the same referent/time.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red/blue position entries), an origin/organization entry, and a distinct status-like field are present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: A processing/origin entry is explicitly co-located with the content entry for the same referent/time, linking processing/origin to that content's representation.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify colored content and associated positions for named referents.

D.rationale: Content entries (color/positions) are presented separately from an origin/organization/status entry for the same referent/time, distinguishing content from its organizational/status information.

O.rationale: Origin/organization metadata explicitly describes how the listed content entries are organized, inherited or represented for named referents/times.
